text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Top Road, happy birthday! To celebrate, I've prepared an abridged performance of my encounter with you from the opera Legend of the Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto and I also have a celebratory song
to sing!
The performance will be later
today at the
outdoor stage!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Umm... So sorry! My friends are actually
throwing
me a birthday party today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! Of c-c-course! Why wouldn't you
be busy on
your birthday?
S-s-s-sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If you'd like, why don't you come to
my
birthday party?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then you could sing your celebration
song there.
I'd really appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Excellent idea! My mellifluous
voice shall
reach that many more pairs of
ears!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure we wouldn't be
imposing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to have you there! The party's
sure to be
a good time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And as for your opera, would you be
open to
doing it another day?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll go ahead and book the stage
then!
